notes: the client card and the Professional/Salon card are separate blocks in components/role-profile-workspace.tsx. 77d5eac moved only the client one, so the provider step below is the half of the founder report that was still open when this suite was written.

worlds are changed through the app itself: the Profile personalization dialog on /profile, where a tile only previews a world and the Select button under the preview calls saveClientBeautyWorld and PATCHes /api/users/me. The document is then read for data-world, so the six measurements are of the themed surface a visitor ends up on, not of a stored string.

text sizes are set by clicking the S, M and L pills on /settings, and the profile page is then reloaded, which is the path a visitor takes. The world gallery page is development-only and 404s in this production build, so it is not used.

target sizes are measured, not assumed: the avatar edit control and the Edit profile action are asserted against the 24px WCAG 2.2 AA floor. Apple HIG asks for 44pt, which these controls do not reach, and the receipt records the painted size so the founder can decide; the record is not a claim that 44pt is met.

viewport 320x568, 360x640, 375x667, 390x844 and 430x932 in installed Chrome with touch emulation and deviceScaleFactor 2. This is a simulated phone, not a hand-held device, so it does not close the real-device sign-off in FND-01.

nothing off loopback is reached: the route filter aborts every request whose host is not 127.0.0.1 or localhost, the database is a disposable cluster this run creates and drops, and the OTP goes to a loopback stand-in.

the working tree is not clean for this run: M components/role-profile-workspace.tsx. This receipt therefore describes a build made from source with a change on top of 88b73a42305d9b3b3cc1047b43cb1d3160f5f96c, which is how the before pair is taken.
